headline.zh: OpenAI 發布 GPT-6 家族指南，詳解推理成本控制與生產級 Agent 落地
headline.en: OpenAI Releases Guide for GPT-6 Family on Reasoning Effort and Production Agents

detail.zh: OpenAI 釋出針對新創與開發者的實踐手冊，指導如何挑選 GPT-6 系列模型、調整推理算力消耗（reasoning effort），以及協同工具建構生產級工作流。對開發者而言，這代表高階推論模型的成本與延遲控管已有官方工程化標準可循。
detail.en: OpenAI published an engineering guide detailing how startups should select GPT-6 tier models, tune reasoning effort, optimize prompts, and orchestrate tools for production. It establishes official development standards for balancing latency and compute costs in next-gen reasoning models.

headline.zh: Redis 之父推輕量工具 ds4，主打在本機極速運行 LLM
headline.en: Redis Creator Unveils ds4 for Fast Local LLM Execution

detail.zh: Redis 創始人 Salvatore Sanfilippo (antirez) 推出 dwarfstar (ds4)，旨在提供極度精簡且高效的本機 LLM 推理環境。對於追求低延遲、離線可用性以及厭倦龐大相依套件的邊緣端開發者而言，這是值得一試的極簡替代方案。
detail.en: Salvatore Sanfilippo (antirez), the creator of Redis, announced dwarfstar (ds4), a lightweight and fast runtime for running LLMs locally. It offers an ultra-lean alternative for developers demanding local execution without heavyweight dependencies.

headline.zh: Apple 宣布收緊 macOS「全磁碟存取」權限，防堵 AI Agent 隱私漏洞
headline.en: Apple Tightens macOS 'Full Disk Access' to Mitigate AI Agent Risks

detail.zh: 蘋果表示因應自主 AI Agent 普及，將針對 Full Disk Access 機制實施更嚴格的分級管控，避免模型自動讀取瀏覽紀錄、郵件與私密檔案。此舉將直接衝擊本地端 Coding Agent 與自動化工具在 macOS 上的權限申請與運作流程。
detail.en: Apple is introducing stricter controls around macOS Full Disk Access, warning that increasingly autonomous AI agents pose severe risks to personal files, emails, and browser history. The policy directly impacts how desktop agentic tools request permissions on macOS.

headline.zh: DeepSeek 推出 Harness 桌面端，支援 macOS 與 Windows 本機工作流
headline.en: DeepSeek Launches Harness Desktop for macOS and Windows

detail.zh: DeepSeek 正式上線 Harness 跨平台桌面應用程式，讓工程師能直接在本地整合模型推理環境並調度開發任務。社群對其開箱即用的本地對話與自動化能力給予高度評價，為本地端工作流再添一大利器。
detail.en: DeepSeek released Harness Desktop across macOS and Windows, enabling developers to integrate model inference workflows directly into their desktop environment with minimal friction.

headline.zh: AllenAI 開源 AstaBrief 模型，專門加速研究報告與摘要產出
headline.en: AllenAI Open-Sources AstaBrief for High-Speed Research Report Generation

detail.zh: 艾倫人工智慧研究所（Ai2）將 Asta 系統核心的報告生成模型 AstaBrief 權重釋出至 Hugging Face。該模型針對學術論文提煉與長文快報進行專門微調，大幅縮短文檔摘要的延遲與 Token 消耗。
detail.en: The Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) open-sourced AstaBrief on Hugging Face, the core report-generation model from Asta. It is fine-tuned to quickly extract structured summaries from scientific literature with low latency.

headline.zh: ServiceNow 開源 AutoSynthData：專為企業級 Agent 生成合成訓練資料
headline.en: ServiceNow Introduces AutoSynthData for Enterprise Agent Training Sets

detail.zh: ServiceNow AI 發表 AutoSynthData 框架，協助團隊自動化合成結構化工具呼叫（Tool-calling）與複雜任務路徑的訓練資料。這有助於企業在缺乏高標註成本資料的情況下，快速微調自定義的領域 Agent。
detail.en: ServiceNow AI released AutoSynthData, an automated framework to generate synthetic training datasets for enterprise agents, focusing on complex multi-turn workflows and tool-calling fidelity.

headline.zh: Suno 跨足語音合成，推出可混搭背景音樂的 Speech 生成功能
headline.en: Suno Expands into Voice Generation with New Speech Feature

detail.zh: AI 音樂平台 Suno 推出 Speech 公開測試版，支援根據文本生成擬真旁白並同步生成背景襯底配樂。創作者與開發者現在可以一站式產製播客旁白、廣告配音與多媒體語音素材。
detail.en: AI music platform Suno launched a public beta for 'Speech', allowing users to generate spoken voices and simultaneous background music from text prompts, targeting podcast and media creators.

headline.zh: Chatham Financial 導入 GPT-5.6 與 Codex，交易驗證耗時縮減 85%
headline.en: Chatham Financial Slashes Trade Validation Time by 85% with GPT-5.6 and Codex

detail.zh: 資本市場諮詢公司 Chatham Financial 揭露其導入 OpenAI 模型的生產細節，透過 Codex 與 GPT-5.6 重構複雜金融工作流，將單筆交易驗證時間從 30 分鐘壓縮至 4 分鐘內，展現垂直領域自動化的具體 ROI。
detail.en: Chatham Financial showcased its production deployment of Codex and GPT-5.6, redesigning capital market workflows and cutting trade validation time from 30 minutes down to under 4.

headline.zh: AI 首次擊敗西洋陸軍棋世界頂尖高手，突破非完全資訊博弈瓶頸
headline.en: AI Conquers Imperfect-Information Game Stratego on a Budget

detail.zh: 長期以來因非完全資訊與廣大搜尋樹而難以被演算法攻克的棋盤遊戲 Stratego，近期被全新 AI 模型以極低算力預算全面擊敗人類歷史頂級棋手，為博弈論與不確定環境下的決策推論帶來突破。
detail.en: Researchers developed an AI system that conquered the classic board game Stratego, defeating top human players on a limited compute budget and overcoming key bottlenecks in imperfect-information game theory.

headline.zh: 探討 Agentic Coding 四大隱患：架構漂移、假性綠燈與維護地獄
headline.en: The Four Horsemen of Agentic Coding: Architectural Decay and False Greens

detail.zh: 知名技術專欄深入分析自動編程 Agent 的瓶頸，指出長期依賴自主寫程式碼容易引發架構漂移、測試覆蓋假象與難以溯源的維護債務。文章呼籲工程團隊應建立更嚴謹的驗證沙盒與約束機制。
detail.en: A widely discussed technical essay analyzes the systemic traps of autonomous coding agents, highlighting architecture erosion and misleading test successes when human review is abstracted away.

headline.zh: 美國逮捕涉案涉走私 3 億美元 Nvidia 晶片至中國之科技公司執行長
headline.en: US Arrests Tech CEO Over Accused $300M Nvidia GPU Smuggling Scheme to China

detail.zh: 美國司法部門逮捕一名涉嫌規避出口管制、走私價值逾 3 億美元高階 Nvidia 運算晶片的科技高層。此事件凸顯先進 AI 晶片黑市供應鏈的猖獗，美國預計將進一步嚴格審查雲端轉運與轉口貿易。
detail.en: US authorities arrested a tech executive accused of illicitly funneling over $300 million in restricted Nvidia chips to China, signaling intensified enforcement on the AI hardware supply chain.

headline.zh: 亞馬遜發長文警告地方勿阻擋資料中心建設，引發環保團體強烈反彈
headline.en: Amazon Warns Public Against Blocking AI Data Centers Amid Power Backlash

detail.zh: AWS 執行長發表逾三千字長文，直言地方阻撓 AI 資料中心建設將重創美國經濟與國安競爭力。然而其淡化能耗與水資源消耗的論調，引來社群與環保團體針對電網負載的更大規模質疑。
detail.en: AWS CEO Matt Garman published a lengthy blog post warning that community resistance to AI data centers threatens economic competitiveness, prompting fierce pushback from environmental groups over grid strain.

headline.zh: Linux 核心維護者 Greg Kroah-Hartman 於演講剖析 LLM 時代的系統安全威脅
headline.en: Linux Kernel Maintainer Greg Kroah-Hartman Talks Systems Security in the LLM Era

headline.zh: Sean Parker 重新整頓 Stability AI，將業務核心全面押注於音樂生成
headline.en: Sean Parker Realigns Stability AI to Focus Purely on Music Generation

headline.zh: 受 AI 晶片短缺與邊緣算力需求波及，上市 7 年的 Nvidia Shield TV 逆勢漲價 100 美元
headline.en: Nvidia Shield TV Pro Jumps $100 in Retail Price Driven by AI Hardware Crunch

headline.zh: 教宗發表聲明批評 AI 算繪作品缺乏「人性火花」，直言統計運算不可等同於藝術
headline.en: Vatican Expresses Skepticism Toward AI-Generated Art Citing Lack of Humanity
